contexts.text: Formerly, they rent their garments. Illustrated, Explained.
To rend the garments = mourning on account of truth destroyed, or because there is no faith. Illustrated. AC 4778.
Instead of a girdle, a rent () = the dissipation of celestial good. (A rent = the dissipation of connection and order. AC 10199:4.) AC 10540:6.
The rending of the mountain... () = the separation of Heaven and Hell.
Like those who rend asunder a covenant.
Like bundles cut asunder with knives and pincers...
To cleave asunder with swords () = the destruction of truth through falsity.
The separation of truth from good... is signified by to rend the caul of their heart ().
